fixes.title: R3-1. Easier to use, the menu group, was completely unstyled: raw browser buttons with 1.02:1 text, because its rows were not direct children of .menu. It is a second .menu now (shared header, rows, icons, hover, focus)
R3-2. Same at phone width, where the group folds under Page tools
R3-3. Read aloud and Describe on the edit toolbar were raw browser buttons (26.8px, 2px border, light fill); now .ibtn like every tool
R3-4. The Type popover covered the selection when there was no room above (round 2 residual). place() now tries the toolbar's far side, the element's other side, then beside it
R3-5. Same for the Color popover
R3-6. Tab did not walk the edit toolbar (round 2 residual): Ctrl+E, Tab ×3 landed on a suggestion chip. Now Hide, Move, Resize, with the tooltip

R3-7. The bar jumped away from a pointer heading for the “mods for this site” chip (and any suggestion), so it could not be clicked. It now steps aside only when the pointer rests on it away from its controls

R3-8. Check this page: five 40px white primary blocks with 70%-opacity notes inside, 18px markers, a × character. Now a 28px .btn per kind with what it does under it, 20px markers, .tbtn and the shared ×
R3-9. Same at phone width: the eyebrow broke over two lines
R3-10. Install review: notes stacked as separate boxes with a 2px border. Notes in a row now read as one box with one label (the 2px warn edge is an inset shadow inside the 1px border)
R3-11. Fix it on a broken mod left the suggestion chips under the working bar
R3-12. For this site: the head was a 54px button and every item button was a 26px copy of .btn; radar at 14px. Now a row with a Show/Hide .tbtn, 28px .btn, radar 16
R3-13. Read aloud: a 36px play button, disabled at 35% opacity, a ×-character close, a 32px outlined speed box. Now 32px .ibtn (disabled --m-signal-1), .btn speed, the shared ×
R3-14. Update review: the diff showed a textarea resize grip and turned => into an arrow ligature. No grip, ligatures off in every code view
R3-15. Share card caption (round 2 residual): 13px #8e8e96, about 8px once the card sits in the dialog. Now 15px #a0a0a8 (7.4:1), footer 17px
R3-16. A toast covered the open bar's status row (Fix it, Capture, Save). With the bar at the bottom, toasts show at the top
R3-17. Version history rows were 25px (off the grid); now 24px
R3-18. Show code drew => as an arrow ligature
R3-19. Toast close was a 16px × character in its own button copy; now the shared .ibtn.close
R3-20. Trying a mod: its two buttons (now Save/Undo) were copies of .btn, the dot pulsed forever; now .btn and a still dot
R3-21. Popup: the focus ring was --m-focus (24% white, about 2:1) at offset 1; now the shared 2px --m-signal-3 ring at offset 2
R3-22. Popup: where each mod came from and Show code sat flush left under the status dot; now aligned under the title
R3-23. Self-heal at phone width: the bar hides its mark there, so the “stopped working” dot vanished from the bar. The mark stays while the dot is on
R3-24. Show me once (new on main) drew its chip icon at 14px (and 12/14px in its strip), off the one 16px set; flagged on every empty-bar shot. Now 16px

1. A page rule (`[data-morse-ui] { display: none !important }`) hid the whole overlay; zoom, dir=rtl and --m-* variables also leaked in. Host styles are now !important, direction is pinned, html zoom is countered, tokens are !important inside the shadow root
2. Hover label off-screen for elements flush with the top edge (every app header)
3. Same on a real site: The Daily Byte's top bar
4. Hover label ran off the right edge
5. 390px: result actions ran off the screen (Share cut)
6. 390px: hint clipped mid-word, model label off-screen
7. Long result title pushed Share out of the bar and hid the timing
8. Long error clipped mid-glyph with no ellipsis (text-overflow on a flex box)
9. Light theme: warning text #e5a54b on white was 2.0:1 (new light --m-warn #8a5300, 5.5:1)
10. --m-text-3 failed AA in both themes (2.9–3.6:1): placeholder, model label, timings, field labels, row buttons. Now #86868e / #6a6a72 (≥4.5:1 worst case)
11. Focus ring was 24% white (~2:1); now --m-signal-3, 2px, offset 2
12. Switch had no focus indicator at all
13. Unbroken titles overflowed the panel; disabled rows dropped to 50% opacity (below AA)
14. Code modal wrapped code and floated × mid-title
15. Toast had no max width (one 950px line)
16. prefers-reduced-motion was ignored: the effect pinged, scanned and blinked; now a calm static field that fades
17. Phone width: the edit toolbar ran 130px off screen. Now the tag and group lines drop and the eleven 32px tools fit in one 360px row (wrapping if narrower)
18. Toolbar focus was a 1px inset line, and a focused tool's tooltip stayed up while hovering another (two tooltips). Now the shared 2px ring, one tooltip at a time
19. Same in light: the 1px ring is now the 2px --m-signal-3 ring every control uses

20. Settings sheet: the edit toolbar sat on top of the bar, the picker's hover box drew through the sheet and the page showed through it. The sheet is solid now, the toolbar steps aside and pointing pauses
21. An invalid hex color looked exactly like a valid one. The field now turns --m-danger (pattern + :invalid)
22. Page tools: the button's tooltip covered its own open menu, and the menu used a different focus style than the ⋯ menu
23. Two menus, two designs: the ⋯ menu had 34px rows, 5px padding and 2px-bottom key caps. Both are one .menu now (32px rows, 4px padding, shared caps)
24. Light theme: a rejected hotkey's message was #f2555a on white (3.4:1). Light --m-danger is #c4262e (5.6:1), and the field gets the same red ring as other invalid fields
25. “Rebuilt from” never showed: the bar turned working before the request picked up the snapshot, so the chip row hid. One re-render after the hook
26. The bar row mixed three icon sizes (14/15/16px), three strokes (1.8/1.6/1.5) and three button sizes (30/32 with r 8). Now 32px .ibtn squares, 16px icons, 1.5px strokes
27. Suggestion chips were 26px pills inset 42px; now quiet 28px .btn on the bar's 16px inset
28. Type popover: 30px stepper buttons with 14px icons, a second segmented-control design. Now 24px .ibtn in a .field, and the shared .seg
29. Capture: the footer hint wrapped to two lines and the key cap was a third style. Shorter hint, shared .btn.primary with the inverse cap
30. Phone width: the input was squeezed to “Des” (with a stray scrollbar) and segmented controls crowded their labels. The mark gives way, the chip caps at 40%, segments drop under their label
31. Hostile page: `[data-morse-ui] { display: none !important }` hid the text being edited in place (Publish vanished). The edit span now holds its display with !important
32. Key caps had three designs (16px inline, 20px with a 2px bottom border and r 5, borderless in tooltips). One cap: 1px line, r 4, 16px inline / 20px in sheets and menus
